exposure: Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative (BFHI) compliance (specifically Steps 4 and 6)
mode of birth (planned caesarean section, emergency caesarean section)
outcome: breastfeeding initiation within one hour of birth
cohort: Women with a live baby across four government hospitals in Sri Lanka were included in the study.
finding: Compliance with BFHI Steps 4 (mother-baby skin-to-skin contact) and 6 (no supplementation) attenuates the negative effect of caesarean section on breastfeeding initiation within one hour of birth.
mod_finding: BFHI Step 4 partially and completely mediated the effect of planned caesarean section and emergency caesarean section, respectively, on breastfeeding initiation within one hour of birth, and BFHI Step 6 partially mediated the effect of emergency caesarean section.
cross-section timing: Within the first hour after birth
